messages:
maria_pm: Heads-up — we need to finalize the PRD acceptance criteria for the new usage policy surface (rate limits / quotas / billing behavior) before next week's roadmap review. Main open items: overage handling semantics, UI copy for limits, API schema changes, and rollout plan.

ashwin_eng: thanks — can we list the possible overage actions we want to support? current idea: 1) hard block (429), 2) soft throttle (queue/delay), 3) allow + bill (overage). Also a grace mode for newly created keys for first N requests.

jules_pricing: prefer "allow + bill" for enterprise by default, but policy must be configurable per-tenant. billing unit needs to be explicit: tokens vs requests. we bill per-token for generation endpoints; embeddings are per-embedding unit. need to confirm how middleware aggregates token counts for batched requests.

sam_support: from customer tickets — customers expect clear UI: current usage, projected end-of-period usage, and an estimated overage cost. If we implement grace_period, support needs a clear reason code in logs to tell customers why a request succeeded during grace.

anya_prodops: rollout constraints: feature flags per-org, telemetry events for every over-limit decision, and a migration path for existing orgs with custom throttles. Also need a default fallback model routing when a request is blocked for quota reasons (low-tier fallback).

ashwin_eng: API sketch for new fields (draft):
```
POST /v1/requests
{
  "model": "gpt-*-redwood",
  "input": "...",
  "billing_hint": { "unit": "tokens", "estimated_tokens": 420 },
  "meta": { "org_id": "org_123" }
}
```
Server may return headers: `X-Quota-Remaining`, `X-Quota-Reset`, `X-Overage-Action` (values: `block`, `throttle`, `allow_and_bill`).

maria_pm: Nice. Acceptance criteria proposal (short):
- Behavior: every org can set per-route quota policy (limit window, unit, overage_action) via Console + API.
- API: response headers present and consistent; error code `429` for block; `202` with `Retry-After` for throttle.
- Billing: overage events emit invoiceable records with `billing_unit`, `units_consumed`, `rate` linked to pricing table.
- UI: Console shows current period, projected end-of-period usage, and a clickable cost estimate.
- Telemetry: events for `quota_exceeded`, `quota_throttled`, `quota_overage_billed` with org_id and request_id.

jules_pricing: add acceptance item: pricing integration must prevent double-billing on retries — idempotency key required in billing records. Also policy should allow a charge cap per org to avoid surprise invoices (soft cap + notify, hard cap with block).

ashwin_eng: edge cases we need to call out:
- batched requests where tokens split across sub-requests (ensure rounding rules).
- cached responses that don't consume tokens (should not count).
- partial responses where model aborts mid-stream — bill by produced tokens.
- concurrent bursts crossing multiple windows (atomic decrement rules).

sam_support: examples for UI copy:
- "You have used 78% of your monthly tokens. Estimated extra cost if you continue: $12.50"
- For hard block modal: "This organization has hit its configured usage cap. Contact billing to raise limits."

anya_prodops: rollout checklist bullets:
- feature-flag gate per org
- create migration job to attach default policy to orgs without one
- QA: simulate 10k requests/s with mixed token sizes and validate headers and billing records
- canary cohorts: 1% -> 10% -> 100% over two weeks

maria_pm: scope negotiation note: for launch MVP we should ship: configurable overage action (block/allow_and_bill), console usage + estimate, API headers, and telemetry. Defer per-route quotas and throttling queues to v1.1 unless we have capacity.

ashwin_eng: ack on deferring throttling queues — implementing queueing has nontrivial cost to latency SLO. We'll prototype metric hooks now so adding queue later is easier.

jules_pricing: will draft billing items: idempotency, cap controls, invoice visibility. ping me when the API fields are stable.

deploy-bot: Deploy notice: feature-flag infra change merged to staging at 1765432123; run smoke tests on staging after API updates.

maria_pm: thanks all — I'll update the PRD with acceptance criteria and the MVP scope and post a snapshot later today for review. If anyone has critical objections to deferring per-route quotas/throttles, shout now. :thumbsup:
